Implementation Details for Industrial Clusters#

Note

This section is under construction.

The following topics will be documented here:

Network structure#

Coming soon — description of the PyPSA network topology, bus structure, and multi-energy carrier representation.

Technology modelling#

Coming soon — implementation details for:

  • Alkaline electrolysis (partial load, degradation)

  • Biomethanation (ramp limits, minimum load, biological constraints)

  • Catalytic methanation (thermal inertia, start-up)

  • Biomass belt dryer (semi-empirical model)

  • Compressors (physics-based sizing)

Stochastic optimisation#

Coming soon — formulation of the two-stage stochastic LP, scenario coupling, and EVPI calculation.

Shapley value cost allocation#

Coming soon — game-theoretic cost allocation across industrial partners using the Shapley value, based on coalition optimisation runs.

RFNBO compliance#

Coming soon — implementation of additionality and temporal correlation constraints for renewable hydrogen certification.

Shadow prices and internal market#

Coming soon — interpretation of dual variables as internal market prices for hydrogen, CO₂, heat, and biomethane.
